svg.title: One address, every website
svg.desc: This repository and the repository of every project each publish a website with a Docs workflow of their own, all at dennis-otto.github.io. That of this repository is the root of the address, with the home page, the 404 page, robots.txt, security.txt, llms.txt for AI assistants, the icons, the short address of the dashboard and the old addresses of a project whose repository was renamed, such as /ha-autodarts/, which lead to its folder now. That of each project is a folder named after its repository, such as /homedarts-for-autodarts/, with a 404 page of its own. The root names the sitemap and the address of every website of the projects. Browsers, crawlers, AI assistants and security researchers get the files of the root and the answer to every address that leads nowhere from this repository, and the pages of a project from the repository of that project.
